_help: Copy to models.json. Each entry points at a model folder or a Hugging Face repo. Only list what you have trained.

luo._note: Folder saved by ml/train_asr.ipynb (or e.g. "jeotamedia/whisper-small-luo"). language_token: see the notebook's WHISPER_LANGUAGE.

_example_en->luo._note: Keys are "source->target" in Ndimi codes; "*->luo" matches any source. Remove the leading _ to switch an entry on.

_example_luo._note: Any Hugging Face text-to-speech model (e.g. a VITS/MMS voice fine-tuned on your recordings). Remove the leading _ to switch it on.

models._help: Keys must match the AI model keys in Ndimi (Settings > AI models). Ndimi sends the key it chose for each language.

madlad-400._note: Apache-2.0: commercial use allowed. Has Maa, Kiswahili, Somali; not Dholuo, Gĩkũyũ, Kalenjin.

nllb-200._note: CC-BY-NC-4.0: non-commercial. Ndimi only uses it with 'Allow non-commercial models' on (internal tests).

_mms-tts._note: CC-BY-NC-4.0: non-commercial. Check which mms-tts-<code> checkpoints exist before listing a language. Remove the leading _ to switch on.

_ndimi-voices._note: Our own voices trained on AfriVoices-KE. Remove the leading _ to switch on.
